_comment: Cards that exist only for the becomes-crewed trigger tests (tests/unit/triggers/test_becomes_crewed.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_crew_watcher` gains life whenever it becomes crewed, so a test can count crewings; `t_vehicle_lifter` animates a target Vehicle the way Mobilizer Mech's trigger does, which is not crewing it.

cards.name: Test Crew Watcher
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever this Vehicle becomes crewed, you gain 2 life.
Crew 1 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 1 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)
